description: This file contains utility functions for handling protection metadata in GStreamer pipelines, specifically for extracting encryption-related information from GstRialtoProtectionMetadata structures and processing GstBuffer objects.

classes.name: GstMappedBuffer
classes.description: A helper class for mapping GstBuffer data for reading.

methods.name: getEncryptedFromProtectionMetadata
methods.description: Extracts the 'encrypted' boolean flag from protection metadata.

methods.name: getMediaKeySessionIdFromProtectionMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves the media key session ID from protection metadata.

methods.name: getKIDFromProtectionMetadata
methods.description: Extracts the key ID (KID) from protection metadata.

methods.name: getIVFromProtectionMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves the initialization vector (IV) from protection metadata.

methods.name: getSubSamplesFromProtectionMetadata
methods.description: Extracts subsample information for encrypted media from protection metadata.

methods.name: getInitWithLast15FromProtectionMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves the 'init_with_last_15' flag from protection metadata.

methods.name: getEncryptionSchemeFromProtectionMetadata
methods.description: Determines the encryption scheme used based on protection metadata.

methods.name: getEncryptionPatternFromProtectionMetadata
methods.description: Extracts encryption pattern details such as crypt and skip blocks.

methods.name: ProcessProtectionMetadata
methods.description: Main function to process GstBuffer and extract all relevant protection metadata into a BufferProtectionMetadata object.
